title: LookaheadKV: Fast and Accurate KV Cache Eviction by Glimpsing into the Future without Generation
authors: Jinwoo Ahn; Ingyu Seong; Akhil Kedia; Junhan Kim; Hyemi Jang; Kangwook Lee; Yongkweon Jeon
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression

problem_statement.en: KV cache size grows linearly with input length, making memory a bottleneck for long-context inference. Existing low-cost eviction heuristics estimate prompt-token importance inaccurately, while draft-based future-attention methods improve eviction quality only by adding costly response generation and substantial prefill overhead.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache 容量隨 input length 線性成長，使記憶體成為 long-context inference 的瓶頸。既有低成本 eviction heuristic 對 prompt token 重要性的估計不夠準確，而 draft-based future-attention 方法雖可改善 eviction 品質，卻須額外執行高成本的 response generation，並造成顯著的 prefill overhead。

key_innovation.en: LookaheadKV appends 32 learnable lookahead tokens and selectively activated lookahead LoRA modules during prefill, distilling true future-response attention distributions with a KL-divergence objective. Lookahead-to-prompt attention then predicts per-layer and per-head token importance so that only Top-K prompt KV pairs are retained, without generating a draft response.
key_innovation.zh: LookaheadKV 在 prefill 階段加入 32 個 learnable lookahead tokens 與選擇性啟用的 lookahead LoRA modules，並以 KL-divergence objective 蒸餾真實 future response 的 attention distribution。lookahead-to-prompt attention 隨後預測逐 layer、逐 head 的 token 重要性，使系統無須生成 draft response 即可僅保留 Top-K prompt KV pairs。

baselines_compared: FullKV, SnapKV, PyramidKV, StreamingLLM, LAQ, SpecKV

key_improvements.en: LookaheadKV reports less than 2.16% eviction overhead at 32K context length and up to a 14.5× overhead reduction versus draft-based approaches; empirically, its 32K TTFT overhead is 38.04 ms versus 553.68 ms for LAQ.
key_improvements.zh: LookaheadKV 在 32K context 下報告低於 2.16% 的 eviction overhead，且相較 draft-based 方法最高降低 14.5×；實測 32K TTFT overhead 為 38.04 ms，而 LAQ 為 553.68 ms。

selection_signal: Draft / lookahead attention, Learned / distilled scorer

reuse_metric.en: At cache budget C = 128 on LLaMA3.1-8B, LookaheadKV records a 47.72 average LongBench score versus 49.88 for FullKV, while exceeding LAQ (46.61), SpecKV (45.45), and SnapKV (43.50).
reuse_metric.zh: 在 LLaMA3.1-8B、cache budget C = 128 下，LookaheadKV 的 LongBench 平均分數為 47.72，FullKV 為 49.88；其結果高於 LAQ (46.61)、SpecKV (45.45) 與 SnapKV (43.50)。
